2116859662867771478.en_summary: Yes. In EM you would have just had a currency devaluation. The Euro zone has delayed that devaluation with these TARGET2 flows. Easiest way to see this is to think what would happen if TARGET2 goes to zero. It would require the ECB to sell all its sovereign debt holdings. Yields would spike and we’d be in a big crisis.
2116859662867771478.zh_summary: 是的。在新興市場你只會有貨幣貶值。歐元區通過這些TARGET2流量延遲了那次貶值。最簡單的方式是想象TARGET2歸零會發生什麼。這將要求ECB出售其所有主權債務持倉。債息將急昇，我們將陷入大危機。

2116859119546089544.en_summary: The problem is that German politicians and their proxies at the ECB know all this very well, but everyone has an incentive to kick the can a little further down the road so that the eventual and inevitable blow-up doesn’t happen on their watch. What’s needed are claw-backs so these people act responsibly and don’t scurry off before the blow-up.
2116859119546089544.zh_summary: 問題是德國政治人物及其在ECB的代理人非常清楚這一點，但每個人都有動機把問題再往後推一點，以便最終不可避免的爆發不會發生在他們的任期內。需要的是追索機制，讓這些人負責任並不在爆發前逃之夭夭。

2116857457540550699.en_summary: No. Germany’s TARGET2 claims are basically the counterpart to artificial yield caps and big currency overvaluations on the high-debt periphery. There is no netting this out. Without these claims, periphery currencies would have devalued massively and of course they still might one day…
2116857457540550699.zh_summary: 不。德國的TARGET2債權基本上是高債務外圍國家人為債息上限及貨幣大幅高估的對應物。這無法輕算消。若沒有這些債權，外圍貨幣已經大幅貶值，當然它們有一天仍可能這樣做…

2116853934887153750.en_summary: No. Easiest way is to draw the contrast with any EM debt crisis. Private capital flows collapse and the currency devalues. That’s not possible in the Euro, so private flows got replaced by official ones, ie ECB purchases of public debt under QE. That artificially caps yields and props up currencies that are really much weaker.
2116853934887153750.zh_summary: 不。最簡單的方式是與任何新興市場債務危機對比。私人資本流動崩潰並貨幣貶值。這在歐元不可能，所以私人流動被官方流動取代，即ECB在QE下購買公債。這人為壓制債息並支撚事實上更弱的貨幣。

2116852542638264735.en_summary: Dollar, rates and oil all going up... all three tighten financial conditions, which leads liquidity, which leads markets. Crypto needs those three to dissipate. Coming into the midterms Trump wants oil, rates and the dollar down. Oil probably gets done via an Iran resolution... Thats what reignites the ability to take risk and brings capital back into markets.
2116852542638264735.zh_summary: 美元、利率和油價全都在上升…這三者都緊縮金融條件，從而帶動流動性，再帶動市場。加密貨幣需要這三者消散。中期選舉即將到來，特朗普希望油價、利率和美元下降。油價可能通過伊朗解決方案完成…這將重新點燃風險承受能力並把資本帶回市場。
